headline: Viceroy Hotels Limited announces proposed rights issue
sum: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the NSE of a proposed rights issue to raise capital for growth and debt reduction, marking a significant fundraising by the hospitality chain.
detail: Viceroy Hotels Limited, a prominent Indian hospitality company listed on the NSE, has notified the Exchange of a proposed rights issue. The intimation was filed on 23 June 2026. A rights issue allows existing shareholders to subscribe for new shares in proportion to their holdings, typically at a discount to prevailing market price. The specific quantum, issue price, and timeline remain to be detailed in the full scheme circular.
